spec.description: DataformWorkspaceSpec defines the desired state of DataformWorkspace

disableMoves.description: Optional. If set to true, workspaces will not be moved if its linked Repository is moved. Instead, it will be deleted.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The DataformWorkspace name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

status.description: DataformWorkspaceStatus defines the config connector machine state of DataformWorkspace

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the DataformWorkspace resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

createTime.description: Output only. The timestamp of when the workspace was created.

dataEncryptionState.description: Output only. A data encryption state of a Git repository if this Workspace is protected by a KMS key.

kmsKeyVersionName.description: Required. The KMS key version name with which data of a resource is encrypted.

internalMetadata.description: Output only. All the metadata information that is used internally to serve the resource. For example: timestamps, flags, status fields, etc. The format of this field is a JSON string.

privateResourceMetadata.description: Output only. Metadata indicating whether this resource is user-scoped. For `Workspace` resources, the `user_scoped` field is always `true`.

userScoped.description: Output only. If true, this resource is user-scoped, meaning it is either a workspace or sourced from a workspace.
